sections.section_title: DMAMUX request line multiplexer interrupt clear flag register (DMAMUX_CFR)
sections.text_helper: Section 12.6.3 "DMAMUX request line multiplexer interrupt clear flag register (DMAMUX_CFR)" in chapter 12 (DMA request multiplexer (DMAMUX)), RM0490 Rev 6, page 254.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x084
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Bits 31:5 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 4:0 CSOF[4:0]: Clear synchronization overrun event flag
Writing 1 in each bit clears the corresponding overrun flag SOFx in the DMAMUX_CSR
register.
